groups: Sign-up awaiting email confirmation, sign-in errors, sign-in, reset request, password update and explicit profile update use the real REST client against a controlled Auth/Data API double; sign-in never copies or uploads progress.
Guest import requires a valid confirmation, keeps the guest save, opens an account slot and does not upload automatically. Upload is separately confirmed and uses returned server timestamps.
Concurrent cloud updates, changed local snapshots and lost success responses cannot be retried blindly. Network failures preserve local progress; Check cloud reconciles an ambiguous upload.
Restore confirms the source and destination, rechecks cloud and local revisions, preserves the prior device story for export, retains story identity and aborts safely on storage quota failure.

Sign-out invalidates pending confirmations, account B cannot upload account A’s local story, per-account local/cloud rows remain separate, first-insert races conflict, and offline sign-out clears local credentials with a revocation retry.
Session resume, expiry refresh, recovery callbacks with immediate URL credential removal, password update and a delayed sign-in arriving after sign-out are covered.

Review mode makes zero Auth/Data API calls, review provenance survives file imports, credentials/gallery/media/oversized/invalid snapshots are rejected, and the game guards against stale-tab local overwrites.
